公司簡介
Company Profile
康師傅控股有限公司（「本公司」）及其附屬                           Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp. (the “Company”), and its
公司（「本集團」）主要在中國從事生產和銷                           subsidiaries (the “Group”) specialise in the production and distribution
售 方 便 麵 及 飲 品。 本 集 團 於 1992 年 開 始              of instant noodles and beverages in the People’s Republic of China (the
生 產 方 便 麵， 並 自 1996 年 起 擴 大 業 務 至              “PRC”). The Group started its instant noodle business in 1992, and
方便食品及飲品；2012 年 3 月，本集團進                        expanded into instant food business and beverage business in 1996.
一步拓展飲料業務範圍，完成與 PepsiCo                         In March 2012, the Group further expanded its beverage business by
中國飲料業務之戰略聯盟，開始獨家負責                             forming a strategic alliance with PepsiCo for the beverage business in
製 造、 灌 裝、 包 裝、 銷 售 及 分 銷 PepsiCo               the PRC. The Company exclusively manufactures, bottles, packages,
於 中 國 的 非 酒 精 飲 料。「康 師 傅 」作 為 中                distributes and sells PepsiCo soft drinks in the PRC. After years of hard
國家喻戶曉的品牌，經過多年的耕耘與積                             work and accumulation, “Master Kong” has become one of the best-
累，深受中國消費者喜愛和支持。                                known brands among consumers in the PRC.

康師傅作為快消品行業的領導品牌，肩負                             Being a leading brand in the fast moving consumer goods industry,
引領行業食品安全與質量保障的使命，本                             Master Kong has to hold the industry responsibility of food safety
集團不斷構建和完善管理體系，建立風險                             and quality guarantee. The Group constantly builds and improves
預防管理機制，實施食品安全的全方位控                             management system, establishes risk prevention management system,
制，確保產品質量與安全，為廣大消費者                             implements entire control over food safety and ensures product quality
提供安全、美味、健康的食品。                                 and safety. We will constantly strive for product quality and food safety,
                                               as well as provide consumers with safe, tasty and healthy food products.

本集團不斷完善遍佈全國各地的銷售網                              The Group distributed its products throughout the PRC through
絡， 令 新 產 品 更 加 快 速、 有 效 地 登 陸 市                its extensive sales network consisting of 348 sales offices and 303
場，使得集團產品處於行業領先地位。截                             warehouses serving 76,875 wholesalers and 217,087 direct retailers
至 2023 年 12 月 31 日，本集團共擁有 348                  as of 31 December 2023. This extensive sales network is a significant
個營業所及 303 個倉庫以服務 76,875 家經                     contributor to the Group’s leading market position and it enables the
銷商及 217,087 家直營零售商。                            Group to introduce new products rapidly and effectively.

本公司於 1996 年 2 月在香港聯合交易所有                       The Company was listed on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited
限公司上市。於 2023 年 12 月 31 日，本公                    in February 1996. Market capitalisation as at 31 December 2023 was
司之市值達 536 億港幣。現時本公司為摩                          HK$53.6 billion. The Company is a constituent stock of Morgan Stanley
根士丹利資本國際 (MSCI) 中國指數成份股                        Capital International (MSCI) China Index and Hang Seng Index.
及恒生指數成份股。

今後，本集團仍將發展焦點集中於食品製                             Focused on food manufacture, sales and distribution business, the
造、行銷及流通行業，並繼續強化通路與                             Group will continue to strengthen its logistics and sales network in the
銷售系統網絡，以建立「全球最大中式方                             PRC with target of becoming “The largest Group for Chinese Instant
便食品及飲品集團」為奮鬥目標。                                Food & Beverage in the World”.

    06   康師傅控股有限公司
         TINGYI (CAYMAN ISLANDS) HOLDING CORP.
主席報告
Chairman’s Statement
康師傅作為中國食品飲料行業領先的民族                  Master Kong, as a leading national brand and company in China’s food
品牌企業，始終致力於為消費者帶來「歡                  and beverage industry, has committed to providing consumers with “Life
樂飲食，美好生活」。我們提供健康、美                  + Delicacy”. The endeavors are there to bring joy to consumers in every
味的產品，滿足不同消費者、不同場景的                  bite they have with healthy and delicious products suitable for different
消費需求，為消費者的每一口帶來歡樂。                  consumer groups as well as consumption occasions.

面 對 2023 年 的 市 場 變 化， 集 團 堅 持 長 期   In face of market changes in 2023, the Group adhered to long-termism
主義，追求有質量的發展。逐步改善毛利                  and pursued quality development. Gradual improvement had been
結構，積極投資品牌的年輕化建設，完善                  made in gross margin structure, and active investments had been made
食安風險管理，助力業績平穩增長。                    in brand rejuvenation and food safety risk management, bolstering the
                                    stable growth of performance.

這一年來，集團持續產品創新、品牌建設                  Over the year, the Group had kept on with product innovation, branding
和渠道建設。加大基礎研究投入，加速人                  and channel development. Investment in basic research had been
才梯隊建設，加強系統平台整合，加快數                  intensified, talent echelon development accelerated, system platform
字化轉型。持續食品安全及可持續發展項                  integration strengthened, and digital transformation expedited. Efforts
目的推進，同時推動業務增長，更好服務                  had been made to continue to promote food safety and sustainable
客戶及消費者並為股東創造價值，打造一                  development, drive business growth, better serve customers and
個讓政府放心，合作夥伴開心，消費者安                  consumers, create value for shareholders, and establish a comprehensive
心的綜合性食品飲料「民族品牌」。                    food and beverage “National Brand” that is trustworthy for the
                                    government, delightful for partners, and reassuring for consumers.

2024 年市場仍充滿機會與挑戰。董事會將               The market in 2024 is still loaded with opportunities and challenges. The
繼續堅定不移的推動集團各方面高質量發                  Board will continue to un-swervingly promote the Group’s high-quality
展，產品及服務內外部升級，推動讓消費                  development in all aspects, upgrade products and services from within
者實現質的提升和市場上量的合理增長，                  and outside, drive the improvement of product quality for consumers
持續敦促管理團隊健康經營，服務於廣大                  and reasonable growth of total volume consumptions in the market,
消費者。                                and prompt the management team, on an ongoing basis, to operate in
                                    a healthy manner to serve the wide population of consumers.

在此，我對股東、董事會成員、管理層、                  I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to all the shareholders,
員工、合作夥伴及消費者多年來的支持致                  members of the Board, management team, employees, partners and
以衷心感謝！                              consumers for their support over all these years!




魏宏名                                 Wei Hong-Ming
董事會主席                               Chairman of the Board

中國香港                                Hong Kong, China

         1.                                                             食品安全管控與建設                                         1.       Food Safety Control and Construction

                                                                        公司深刻認同「食品安全為企業                                             The Company deeply recognizes that “food safety is
                                                                        生 存 之 本 」，「確 保 食 品 安 全 」                                   the foundation of corporate sustainability” and “food
                                                                        是消費者對品牌的信任基礎。                                              safety” is the foundation to build customers’ brand trust.
                                                                        我們遵守《中華人民共和國食品                                             In compliance with the Food Safety Law of the People’s
                                                                        安全法》等法律法規，以消費者                                             Republic of China and other laws and regulations, we
                                                                        為中心，秉承對食品安全風險                                              place consumers at the center of our operations, adhere
                                                                        「零容忍」的態度，致力於從員                                             to a “zero tolerance” approach towards food safety risks,
                                                                        工道德觀念、專業能力、產品                                              and are committed to enhancing our risk management by
                                                                        制程管理等多方面提升企業風                                              improving the ethics and professionalism of our staff and
                                                                        險管控水平，努力推動「健康中                                             strengthening our product process management, striving
                                                                        國」建設。為此，我們在下述幾                                             to promote the construction of a “healthy China”. In this
                                                                        方面不斷發力，持續優化康師                                              connection, we have been making continuous efforts in the
                                                                        傅食安管理工作水平：                                                 following areas to continuously improve Master Kong’s food

4.   減塑與包裝物管理                      4.   Plastic Reduction and Packaging Management

     康師傅積極響應國家減塑政策                      Master Kong actively responds to the national plastic
     及要求，支持有關環保政策，                      reduction policy and requirement, supports corresponding
     在產品生產週期的各個階段精                      environmental protection policies, and refines packaging
     進包裝物管理工作，在保證產                      management at all stages of the product production cycle,
     品安全與質量要求的前提下減                      reducing the use of plastics and packaging materials while
     少塑料和包材的使用，推動實                      securing the satisfaction for product safety and quality
     現包材輕量化、可循環、可降                      requirements, promoting the realisation of lightweight,
     解、可再生，降低對環境造成                      recyclable, degradable and renewable packaging material,
     的負面影響，貫徹可持續發展                      in order to reduce negative impact on the environment and
     理念。                                implement the concept of sustainable development.

     在產品生產階段，我們制定了                      At the product production stage, we have developed

     理制度，從產品包裝物的各組                      Overconsumption Standard , actively conducted relevant
     成部分積極開展相關研究和探                      research and exploration from various components of
     索， 持 續 推 行 一 系 列 精 進 方             product packaging, continuously implementing a series of
     案，開展減塑減重工作，使用                      improvement programs to reduce plastic usage and weight,
     更環保的包材材質，從源頭減                      utilizing more environmentally friendly packaging materials,
     少包材使用和廢棄物產生。                       and reducing the use of packaging materials and generation
                                        of waste from the source.

     「綠 水 青 山 就 是 金 山 銀 山 」的            of “lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable

     及自身實際情況，制定有關政                      evaluates the risks and opportunities brought by climate

     機制，同時抓住機遇，促成企                      sustainable corporate development. We endeavour to
     業可持續發展。我們努力實現                      achieve resource recycling, explore potential energy-saving
     資源循環利用，挖掘每個環節                      and carbon-reducing opportunities in each link, and drive

本公司致力通過可持續的股息政策，在符                             The Company seeks to maintain a balance between meeting

平衡。本公司的股息政策旨在讓股東得以                             a sustainable dividend policy. The Company’s dividend policy aims
分享本公司的利潤，同時讓本公司預留足                             to allow shareholders to participate in the Company’s profit and for
夠儲備金供日後發展之用。在建議宣佈及                             the Company to retain adequate reserves for future development.

的流動資金水準及未來發展計劃、整體經                             performance, the Group’s liquidity levels and future development plans,

              權益有虧損結餘。                                        interest having a deficit balance.

              於附屬公司相關權益之變動。                                   the changes in their relative interests in the subsidiary.
              少數股東權益之調整金額與已                                   Any difference between the amount by which the non-

           有可能違約事件的 ECL，而 12                           instrument while 12-month ECL represents the portion of
           個月的 ECL 代表預期由金融工                            lifetime ECL that is expected to result from default events
           具的違約事件產生的整個存續                               on a financial instrument that are possible within 12 months
           期 ECL 其 中 部 分， 該 部 分 在 報                    after the reporting date.
           告 日 期 之 後 12 個 月 內 可 能 發
           生。

           如果 ECL 是在集體基礎上計量                            Where ECL is measured on a collective basis, the financial
           的，則金融工具按以下一個或                               instruments are grouped on the following one or more
           多個共享信貸風險特徵分組：                               shared credit risk characteristics:

41. 資本管理                                        41. CAPITAL MANAGEMENT

    本集團的資本管理目標是維護本集                                 The Group’s objectives on managing capital are to safeguard the
    團 持 續 經 營 的 能 力， 為 股 東 提 供 回                    Group’s ability to continue as a going concern in order to provide
    報及為其他持份者提供利益。                                   returns for shareholders and benefits for other stakeholders.

    本集團使用根據淨負債（扣除現金及                                The Group monitors its capital, which comprises all equity
    現金等值物及長期定期存款的有息                                 components, using a gearing ratio which is calculated on the basis
    借 貸 ）計 算 的 淨 負 債 與 資 本 比 率（作                    of net debt (interest-bearing borrowings net of cash and cash
    為本公司股東應佔權益的比率）以監                                equivalents and long-term time deposits) as a ratio of the equity
    察 其 資 本（包 括 所 有 權 益 部 分 ）。 本                    attributable to owners of the Company. The Group takes into
    集團計算淨負債與資本比率時把長                                 account of the long-term time deposits in calculating the gearing
    期 定 期 存 款 計 入 作 考 慮， 因 管 理 層                    ratio because the management believes that this calculation
    認為此計算更準確地反映本集團之                                 reflects the capital structure of the Group more accurately. The
    資 本 結 構。 報 告 期 末 淨 負 債 與 資 本                    gearing ratio at the end of the reporting period was as follows:
    比率如下：

    積 極 定 期 檢 討 和 管 理 資 本 結 構， 並                    structure through the optimisation of the debt and equity

42. 金融風險因素                             42. FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT

  本集團所持有的金融工具面對外匯                          The Group’s financial instruments expose it to foreign currency
